model_output.rationale: All four lines denied OA-18 (exact duplicate) but chart note shows two genuinely separate manual-therapy/exercise sessions billed same DOS with identical codes (97140 x2, 97110 x2) and no distinguishing modifier — the payer's duplicate edit matched line 3 against line 1 and line 4 against line 2. This is a false duplicate: repeat services lacking the modifier that would distinguish them, not one service billed twice.

root_cause.explanation: Lines 3 and 4 duplicate the codes on lines 1 and 2 (97140/97110, same DOS) with no modifier distinguishing the two separate treatment sessions documented in the chart note, tripping the exact-duplicate edit (OA-18/N111).

next_action.detail: Append modifier 76 (repeat procedure, same provider) to the second occurrence of each code (lines 3 and 4) per chart note's two distinct sessions. Medicare Part B FFS: submit via clerical-error reopening, not frequency 7 (not accepted on Part B) and not a new original (claim already adjudicated).

evidence.fact: All 4 SVC lines carry CAS*OA*18 (exact duplicate) with MOA N111; CLP07 2623576767957 confirms adjudication occurred.
Lines 1&3 both bill 97140:GP:KX and lines 2&4 both bill 97110:GP:KX, same DOS 20260705, no modifier distinguishing repeats.
Documents two separate manual-therapy encounters (97140 x2) and two exercise sessions (97110 x2) same day, totaling 76 timed minutes.

citations.rule: False duplicate = legitimate repeat service billed without distinguishing modifier -> correct_and_resubmit, corrected line(s) only
Medicare Part B FFS does not accept frequency 7; modifier correction on adjudicated claim is a clerical-error reopening
